venue.name: Greater Victoria Sports Hall of Fame
venue.description: The Greater Victoria Sports Hall of Fame celebrates the athletes, teams and builders who have contributed to the region's sports history. Its displays are at the Save-On-Foods Memorial Centre, 1925 Blanshard St., reached through Gate Three, and a further display was unveiled at the North Saanich Canadian Tire. The collection shown in the site's Artifacts gallery includes trophies, jerseys, photographs, medals and equipment going back to the early 1900s. The organisation is run by a volunteer board and its site publishes no opening hours, admission price, guided tour or school program.

programs.name: Self-guided visit to the displays
programs.description: The Hall of Fame's displays are inside the Save-On-Foods Memorial Centre at 1925 Blanshard St. and are reached through Gate Three. The site's Artifacts gallery shows what is in the collection: trophies, jerseys, medals, team photographs, old skates and cleats, and championship programs from Victoria clubs going back to the 1910s. The site does not publish opening hours, an admission price, a group rate, a booking route for groups, or any staffed or guided offering, and it does not say whether school or daycare groups are welcome.
programs.what_children_do: Walk in through Gate Three at the arena and look at cases of trophies, jerseys, medals, team photographs and old sports equipment from Victoria teams.
programs.our_note: This is a set of display cases inside a working arena rather than a museum with a front desk, so the first thing to settle is whether the building is open and unticketed on the day you want to come. No staff contact for visits is published. The president's contact form is the only route, and a volunteer board may take a while to answer.
programs.practical_summary: Nothing practical is published: no hours, no admission price, no washroom, lunch, parking or accessibility information for the display area. Because the displays sit inside an event venue, access depends on the arena being open, which is worth confirming before you travel.
programs.evidence: Our displays are seen at the Save-On-Foods Memorial Centre (1925 Blanshard St.) through Gate Three.
